title: Apple, Samsung settle iPhone patent battle
text: Apple, Samsung settle iPhone patent battle Thursday, 28 June 2018 ( 12 hours ago ) Samsung has chosen to settle rather than challenge a ruling that awarded Apple hundreds of millions of dollars last month. Apple had accused the Korean tech giant of copying its iPhone design. ▶ Apple And Samsung Settle Design Patent Violation 01:00 According to Reuters, Apple and Samsung settled a seven-year legal dispute over patented design features.
